Verified by viewing both the raw PNG and the traced SVG: no border/frame/box/margin band anywhere, no starburst/radiating rays/sparkle behind the subject, a single large character on a diagonal-reading X-cross composition with its left/right arm-tips running to the canvas edges (top/bottom keep a small ~20px margin rather than full bleed, accepted as a minor compromise since the hard failure mode — the border — is solidly gone).
